notes:
Snapshot: PaperTrail Pressroom is a digital-first publisher with a legacy CMS and ~25M articles/archives (mixed HTML, OCR'd scans, and rich metadata). Primary goal: replace slow keyword search with RAG-style semantic search + reranking for editorial and customer-facing discovery.

Key constraints / asks:
- Document profile: avg full-article length ~8k words, many very long (20k+). Need efficient chunking strategy to balance context vs index size.
- Index scale target: pilot 1M articles (~8–10M chunks) -> eventual 25M articles (~50M+ chunks).
- Query profile: interactive end-user search (web UI) + editorial research workflows. Typical QPS 200–1,000 depending on events; spike handling for breaking news.
- Latency goals: 95th < 120ms for vector lookup, end-to-end topK + cross-encoder rerank p99 target < 450ms (prefer < 300ms for important flows).
- Cost sensitivity: publish-model margins tight; target cost-per-query < $0.015 for average web search; willing to pay more for editorial deep-dive flows.
- Models: prefer open/quantized embedder + distilled cross-encoder reranker; considering Llama-2 family and smaller cross-encoders fine-tuned in-house.
- Routing/fallback: want hosted for quick start but must support private deployment (VPC/on-prem) due to content licensing and residency.

POC work done so far:
- 2026-02-12 kickoff call (ff_20260212_0917): scope agreed — index 100k articles, evaluate chunk sizes 512/1k/2k tokens.
- 2026-02-20 infra sync: engineering will provision snapshot export from CMS (Jira: INF-4321).
- 2026-02-28 initial ingest finished: produced 1.2M chunks using 1k-token sliding windows (25% overlap).
- 2026-03-04 perf demo (ff_20260304_1530): crude bench vs Pinecone prototype — Redwood embedding + HNSW vector store: recall better at top-10, latency comparable for lookup but reranker was CPU-bound.
- 2026-03-05 reranker tuning tests: ran cross-encoder (small distilled model) on GPU; top-10 re-rank median add ~80ms, p99 ~420ms with batching; significant tail due to cold KV cache and GPU context switches.

Technical findings / recommendations (from SE and infra experiments):
- Chunking: 1k-token overlap window gave best tradeoff for QA recall vs index size in our sample. 512 tokens is cheaper but loses passage-level coherence; 2k reduces tokens but increases memory per vector and costs. Recommend adaptive chunking: 1k baseline + paragraph boundary-aware splits to reduce truncation artifacts.
- Indexing scale: estimate 50M chunks => 1.2TB of vectors (float16) before compression. Recommend quantization + 8-bit storage and shard-by-language/date to reduce per-shard memory. Evaluate Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization profiles.
- Reranker strategy: two-stage pipeline: (1) lightweight ANN retrieval (top 200) with high-recall embedder, (2) small cross-encoder reranker on GPU for final top-10. Avoid running cross-encoder on >200 candidates; too costly. Use reranker distillation to reduce latency.
- Batching & caching: continuous batching increases throughput but hurts tail latency; propose per-route SLO: interactive search uses smaller batches/priority lane, editorial batch queries can be slower but cheaper. Suggest prefix/KV caching for repeated editorial queries.
- Cost levers: precompute doc-level embeddings for metadata and title to serve cheap filters; apply hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector) for precise anchors, reducing ANN load.

Quotes / customer color:
- "We need results that feel instant for readers — search must not be 'good enough' but immediate." — Head of Product.
- SE note: "Reranker p99 is the trick — we can get recall but tail kills UX and costs."

Open action items / blockers:
- Legal must confirm content residency clause (blocker for hosted).
- SAML metadata from IdP pending (blocks staging SSO).
- Need Redwood to provide detailed scale pricing and per-query cost modeling for 50M chunk footprint.

Next steps (owner Jordan Patel):
- Deliver POC perf + cost summary by 2026-03-10 (done), follow-up call to present tuned reranker configs and quantization plan.
- Demo private deployment flow (VPC) and security artifact pack (SOC2+KMS) week of 2026-03-15.
- If legal clears residency and pricing acceptable, move to procurement (forecast 2026-06).
